blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَوْ أَنَّ مَا فِي اْلاَرْضِ مِنْ شَجَرَةٍ أَقْلَامٌ وَّالْبَحْرُ يَمُدُّهُ مِنْ م بَعْدِهِ سَبْعَةُ أَبْحُرٍ مَّا نَفِدَتْ كَلِمتُ اللهِ ؕ إِنَّ اللهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Indeed, even if all the trees on the earth were pens, and the sea (were ink), and after it (had been used up in writing) seven (more) seas were added to it (as ink), the words of Allah would not come to an end (in writing) - indeed Allah is All-Mighty (over all things), All-Wise.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (قُلْ لَنْ يُّصِيبَنَآ إِلَّا مَا كَتَبَ اللهُ لَنَا ۚ هُوَ مَوْلَنَا ۚ وَعَلَي اللهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) say, “Nothing will ever befall us except what Allah has decreed for us; He (alone) is our Protector.” And upon Allah alone let the believers rely.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَإِنْ يَمْسَسْكَ اللهُ بِضُرٍّ فَلَا كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَإِنْ يُّرِدْكَ بِخَيْرٍ فَلَا رآدَّ لِفَضْلِهِ ؕ يُصِيبُ بِهِ مَنْ يَّشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ؕ وَهُوَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: If Allah touches you with harm, there is none who can remove it except Him; and if He intends good for you, there is none who can hold back His grace - He grants it (the good) to whom He wills among His servants - and He is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
